request.prompt: A single glossy die-cut vinyl sticker of a classic yellow Lisbon tram, the iconic vintage streetcar of Lisbon, in three-quarter view. Flat vector illustration with soft, minimal shading and chunky rounded shapes, bold dark eggplant (#2b1b3a) outlines, a limited warm palette of marigold yellow (#ffb320), cream (#faf9f6) and soft periwinkle (#b8c7ff) windows, a thick clean white sticker border all around the shape, and a very subtle soft drop shadow. Centered, isolated on a transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no coins. The roof is cream; the wheels, bumpers and trolley pole are dark eggplant (#2b1b3a); no grey, no black, no red. The destination sign above the windshield is a blank cream panel: no route number, no fleet number and no lettering anywhere on the tram. Keep it simple and iconic, with few bold details. Everything sits inside one single continuous white die-cut outline, with no separate floating pieces, sparkles or crumbs. The sticker fills most of the canvas with a small even margin.
